s: loss-making
loss margin (the ratio of net loss to revenue, or the negative difference between costs and sales price expressed as a percentage)
In der aggressiven Expansionsphase akzeptierte das Start-up eine hohe Verlustmarge, um schnell Marktanteile zu gewinnen.
In its aggressive expansion phase, the start-up accepted a high loss margin to quickly gain market share.
Anhaltende negative Verlustmargen führen zwangsläufig zur Erosion der Eigenkapitalbasis.
Persistent negative loss margins inevitably lead to the erosion of the equity base.
loss carryforward (the carrying over of a net operating loss to future tax years to offset future profits and reduce tax liability)
Durch einen hohen Verlustvortrag aus der Aufbauphase kann das Startup seine Steuerlast in den ersten profitablen Jahren erheblich senken.
Due to a high loss carryforward from the startup phase, the company can significantly reduce its tax burden in the first profitable years.
Das Finanzamt stellt den festverbleibenden Verlustvortrag gesondert fest, damit dieser in künftigen Perioden steuerlich geltend gemacht werden kann.
The tax office separately determines the remaining loss carryforward so that it can be claimed for tax purposes in future periods.
loss carryback (a tax provision that allows a company to apply a current net operating loss to prior years' profits to receive a refund of taxes previously paid)
Durch einen Verlustrücktrag in das vorangegangene Gewinnjahr konnte das Unternehmen seine Liquidität während der Krise durch eine sofortige Steuererstattung verbessern.
Through a loss carryback to the previous profitable year, the company was able to improve its liquidity during the crisis through an immediate tax refund.
Der gesetzlich zulässige Höchstbetrag für einen Verlustrücktrag wurde vorübergehend angehoben, um die wirtschaftlichen Folgen der Pandemie abzufedern.
The legally permissible maximum amount for a loss carryback was temporarily increased to cushion the economic consequences of the pandemic.
